text: I have always like muffuletta sandwiches, and boy am I glad I decided to try this  place. Overlook the grocery store setting, this place has  the best muffuletta I have ever had.

We sat in the little private room toward the back. Service was great as always. The food is all fresh and delicious. Everything comes out hot and cooked to perfection. This is a very cozy restaurant where you can always get a great meal. Perfect for a date or even a big family dinner. Everything tastes good with Meomi Pinot Noir!

Wow, these sandwiches were good. Was visiting Tucson and went back two times as it was that good. Had the cordon bleu as well as the Wednesday special. That pretzel bread is out of this world.

The pasta salad side was also delicious, as was the chips and flavored iced tea.

Super easy process to order online, food was ready when they said it would be and they brought it to my car.

Wish I lived in Tucson, I'd be here once a week or more.

I was a little nervous given all the negative reviews, but I was pleasantly surprised! My pizza arrived earlier than the 90 minute window (maybe around 45 minutes) and was hot, fresh, and tasted great -- and I'm not usually the biggest fan of pizza. The website was easy to use and the delivery driver was really nice, too!
Will definitely be ordering from here again!

Nice place near the hotel.  Sat at the bar for some friendly service.  Limited tap list, but will some good local options.   Mostly sandwiches and good bar food.  Had the fish and chips.  Fish was thinner than I'm used to, but breading was well done corn meal style.   Good energy to the place.  Lots of folks coming in and out.

I went to the new location in gentilly and i was impressed with the building and the menu. I ordered the crawfish fries and they smelled good and looked good. HOWEVER, once I started eating them, I was disappointed. They lacked flavor and I had to add my own seasoning. My fries were also kind of cold but it was fine because I just warmed it up at home. Also, when I kept eating them.. I ended up getting a sour taste in my mouth, it wasn't the crawfish because that tasted fresh. It was the fries, it was either old or have been sitting there for a while. My mom was eating some too and had the same sour old taste in her mouth. We both spit those certain fries out. I ate the majority but threw the rest away. I appreciate the business and the food. I was just disappointed and didn't really like the fries. Overall, I rate the place a 9/10 but my food 4.9/10. I will order something else but I'll stay away from the fries. I hope someone sees this!

I love Han Dynasty, however, the Manuyunk location food is definitely different than the Han Dynasty in Old City and University City. The dishes were a bit more bland with more of an Americanized taste/flavor. The menu options were also a little different, where there was a "traditional dishes" and "American dishes". 

Some locations cater to the demographics of the locations and I definitely think the Manuyunk location caters to a more "American" taste than the authentic flavors. 

If you're looking for a good spicy Sichuan food, I'd recommend trying to the Han Dynasty in University city. That is by far my favorite!
Watch those chicken tacos! Got a bone in one, sent it back and the same thing happened with the replacement order.
I order from here on a weekly basis. The curries are all great, and they even give military discount!

When ordering online double check your order before you drive off to your hotel or home. No eating utensils, no napkins, wrong order, not a complete order. When calling back to speak to the manager who ever answered the phone was very rude!!!
Spinach and broccoli pizza was one of the best slices I've ever had.  Love garlic and there was plenty of it!
Great pizza in the Rose Tree-Media/ Garnet Valley area.  Try the flip-it, you won't be disappointed.

Ate there last night and had the Nashville Hot Chicken sandwich, fries and banana pudding.  The sandwich was probably the best Nashville Hot Chicken sandwich that I have ever had, and believe me when I say I've had a lot!  The banana pudding was also exceptional.  I didn't care for the fries, sadly (they were definitely subpar, especially when compared to everything else).  The service was good, food arrived quickly and hot, and counter workers were very friendly.

I came in and stopped by Christie's deli because the store is close by my place. The owner was very friendly, chatty, and very welcoming. It felt like chit chatting with an old friend who has known for years. 
The owner herself recommended me to give a try of breakfast sandwich special named Christie's breakfast. Did I like it? Ohh I really loved it and the price was super affordable that can't beat this anywhere else! The quality of the food has always been above and beyond!! As always brings happiness to each bite. 
This to-go deli will be my forever sandwich shop and I won't go to another deli. If you have a chance to stop by this deli, I would highly recommend it because you won't regret it!!

Honestly, I think this place is fantastic. The only reason they're getting 4 instead of 5 starts is bc their service is lacking a bit. Servers could be nicer and faster with refills but food wise, I love it. The buffet has a wide selection of foods ranging from fried chicken and French fries to delicious Asian cuisine that I cannot spell or pronounce. The buffet is clean and well maintained, they are great at refilling foods in a timely manner. They've been closed during covid and it's honestly been the most depressing thing for me! Hopefully they open soon so we can head back!!

Omg. Absolutely an amazing meal. The service was incredible and so hopeful. 5 stars all the way. 
We had the Rainbow roll as an appetizer and it was incredible. Fir dinner the steak burger and French dip was our choice and it was amazing 
Will absolutely be back

Just skip it. The portions given don't come close to matching their prices. There's better barbecue in all 4 directions away from Bar-B-Cutie. If I'm paying $35 for it meal, it better not look child's sized. No one pays for tiny plates for pit master meals. The flavor.... Just ok. The value and quantity is too low for ok food.

Brisket: Dry, flavorless... Needs more smoke and seasoning. There is so little... See pic.

I do like their chili and corn bread. But again.... Why pay for ok? It's fine. Not good, great, no delicious.... Just meh...

Love the condiment bar, it's a great idea. This is my 3rd attempt here and every time the workers have been grumpy and the food insanely salty. I ordered to go this time and they put the 2 hot containers on top of each other in a brown bag. The top container melted through the lid of the bottom and the ramen broth poured out all over in my passenger floor board, brand new car. This place definitely could use a little more attention to detail & customer service.

Ambiance: 3/5
As you can tell from the yelp photos of this place, it's gorgeous. I love the aesthetic of vintage-y mirrors and art on exposed brick with cathedral ceiling. But the layout/structure of the building is not ideal for the dining experience I was looking for. The tall ceilings make it incredibly loud, and the table I was sitting at (party of 4) was weirdly enormous--I literally couldn't reach my sisters outstretched arm when she was sitting on the other side. This combined with he ceilings meant that I couldn't hear a damn thing anyone said.

Service: 3/5
Maybe it was our waitress' first day or maybe she was having a rough time (she only had one set of false eyelashes on) but it was not the best experience. She wasn't super knowledgeable about the menu and seemed to struggle with placing our order with those handheld things. My brother in law ordered a cocktail with a specific whiskey and she just brought him the whiskey, neat.

I was here for restaurant week but I didn't see anywhere online that it was served family style--this means we ALL had to agree on every course. Essentially impossible for the four of us. My sister doesn't eat seafood or raw foods and pretty much all my boyfriend and I were interested in were the seafood and raw food so we couldn't do the restaurant week deal which is really the reason we went to try this place out. So that was a fail.

Food: 3/5
Beef tartar: an overpowering taste of horseradish made this impossible to enjoy. Literally burn

Coffee Bureau is one of the best coffee shops in the city and I say this as someone who doesn't really drink coffee (not by choice unfortunately!) While I can't review their coffee, they do make an excellent London fog. They use one of my favourite tea brands (Smith teas) and unlike the fogs you get at most places, it isn't overly sweet. They find a perfect balance. They also have a super tempting selection of baked goods. I don't think I've ever been able to resist.

As good as their drinks and baked goods are, the real highlight of Coffee Bureau is their customer service. All of their staff are friendly and welcoming. Skip the big chains and run to Coffee Bureau. You won't regret it!

My S/O had taken me here as a surprise dinner for my birthday. Our server was extremely helpful with explaining the menu and attentive. 
This was my first time eating here, and won't be my last. The food here is amazing. My S/O had the burger and let me tell you it was so delicious. You know when you order a burger at a restaurant and every time you think it's going to be good but it just lets you down and you never end up finishing it, well guess what this burger was the opposite. It was so juicy and savory, and the beef just melted in our mouths, we weren't expecting that. The salmon was also excellent, the taste was subtle and fresh, and I really enjoyed the charring on the skin. 
When you dine at oyster house you have to get oysters. We got the jalapeño grilled oysters, and I have never tasted anything better in my life. 
I want to come for their happy hour oysters and to get that burger again. 
The only thing I really minded was how close together sitting of the tables were. I just prefer to sit farther apart from other tables just because this restaurant's ambiance is more intimate.

We ordered the Figgy Toast and bowl (special of the day) with jerk chicken, quinoa, butternut squash, asparagus, drizzle/dressing.

Soooo good!

Great Guacamole some of the best I have ever had and Margaritas are nice and strong. The short ribs (AH-mazing and tender. The hostess is cold and not very welcoming, she was in the phone when we walked in continued her conversation that seemed long (she was taking a reservation) when she got off the phone she continued writing never lifted her head and maybe 2 minutes later she said yes hello ‍wth lol... It took her forever to even acknowledge us standing there she does not need to be at the front of the house. My recommendation is to definitely go check it out good food and reasonable prices, just ignore the rude hostess I'm sure she'll do the same to you. Would of ya e 4 stars took one away for the hostess dining out is an overall experience not just the food.

I want to start this review off by saying that I understand it's very difficult for restaurants to operate during COVID-19, so I tried to cut GreenHouse a lot of slack. However, we had a pretty poor experience. 

We decided on outdoor seating at one of the fire pit tables outside. One of our heatlamps and the firepit were out of propane. The waitress came over and took our drink orders and said they'd switch the propane tanks. 

We were more than patient, but it took 25 minutes to get them switched, during which we were freezing. Then, it took another 15 minutes on top of that to get our drinks.

That's 40 minutes of waiting, mostly in the cold, just to get drinks. That's a bad look at any restaurant anytime. 

The food came out quick enough after. We got the bacon appetizer, which was delicious. Very happy with that.

But the entrees left a lot to be desired. My burger wasn't very flavorful and my girlfriend's venison chops were burnt.

On top of that... a few hours later, she got food poisoning. Seeing as we hadn't eaten anything else since noon, it was almost definitely GreenHouse's venison chops. 

I don't like writing bad reviews. But unfortunately, I had to for this experience. I hope they improve their operations.

Best place to eat authentic German food. German beer and wine, We love their bakery - Black Forest cake and all sorts of cookies - can be ordered ahead of time or by the slice. I hear they have dancing too.
Delicious ! Staff is friendly, the owner is very attentive and friendly! Highly recommend. And they also serve delicious Thai tea, my fav.

Came here on a Saturday evening and had a wonderful time! Drinks were good, food was fantastic and the live music was a plus. Came around 630 and had to wait about 5 minutes for a table, not bad at all! Service was prompt and friendly as well

Lilac is my hands-down everyday favorite. Check their website for the special soup and salad of the day. My favorite cake is the berry patch, my partner's is the chocolate decadence. I love their breakfasts, sandwiches, chocolate chip cookies, and coffee drinks. Simply put, everything is so good.
Delicious food and great service. Our party number kept growing and they were beyond accommodating. Even when our group got a little loud. We will definitely be back for another celebration!

I love the classic sandwiches and homemade soups from this little deli.  We have been lucky in the last few weeks to have caught the truck out and about.  Yummy wonderfulness.  I signed up for the app for deals, promos and to find out where they are at.  What an effective thing!  Thank you Paisan's for the full belly and great service several times in the last few months!

I've tried the pretzel, maui and padaro burger and they all hit the spot! My favorite is the maui because the pineapple really adds a fresh taste and goes well with teriyaki. Serving sizes are generous. Love how they have many options from fish to salads to chili. Something here for everyone to enjoy  Thank you to all the essential workers at Padaro Beach Grill, you guys rock

We had a lovely birthday dinner for 5 on a Tuesday evening.  The Bruschetta was terrific.  All entrees ordered were delicious.  We had eggplant parm, gnocchi, rigatoni and a lovely salad.  Our server Susie surprised our table with a delicious cannoli.  So glad to have tried Buona for the first time.  As a new resident nearby we will definitely be back.

Teryaki Madness is one of my favorite places to eat in Wesley Chapel! I go to the one in Wiregrass Mall and it is ALWAYS good! I have never once had a bad meal/experience here. The staff is super nice and the managers are always friendly and helpful. If you want a new place to try, this is the place!

This seems like a classic Italian neighborhood pizzeria with the twist that it's all vegan! 
I was so happy with their classic menu and that they didn't try to make everything healthy. The pizza, wings, cheesesteak, chick'n sandwich and cookies were all delicious! You could bring a carnivore here and they would be happy. 
The vegan cheesesteak was the best we tried in Philly!

This restaurant has so much potential but it has become blah. Had lunch there today. All the tables were dirty. Trash scattered everywhere. Silverware dirty. My food was barely warm. I never send my meal back unless it's really bad. I sent it back this time. I've been a once a month customer and it used to be well run.
The last 2-3 visits not so much. Very disappointing.


Follow up to original post:
I sent an email as requested but got no reply after a week. I guess she's not really interested. Sad.

Disappointing lunch experience. I did feel sorry for the one woman working. She was overwhelmed and trying to train the person in the kitchen. One lobster roll, two lobster grilled cheese, kids quesadilla and cup of lobster bisque was $75.

The only thing worth ordering is the lobster roll period. If there was a next time I'd only get that to go, but most likely I will only be eating at the food truck. Lobster bisque was Luke warm and NOT good. Is it supposed to have chunks of lobster? This one did not.  The kids quesadilla was $7.50 with tots. The cheese on it was sparse maybe 1/3 of it had cheese. I wouldn't recommend ordering kids meals here. We ordered waters and they gave us the small plastic cups with no lids so of course my 3 year old spilled hers. The woman working was too overwhelmed to ever clean it up or give us a rag because we would have. 

No one likes cole slaw, and this one is nothing special at that, please change it as your included side! Maybe fresh fruit or something with fresh herbs? My husband described the grilled cheese as bland. I think fresh herbs and seasonings would help. Tots are a thumbs down.  The two stars only for the good quality of the actual lobster alone.

We were told the person in the kitchen was in training so this could attribute to the experience. I do think there is huge potential here, but if they don't improve their menu and service i don't see this location doing well. People drive here from far for the lobster hype, Smyrna is not

It wasn't anything great I'm from out of state and came here because I seen how many reviews it had which had me expecting something better.. my husband and I ordered the boo fries as an appetizer which was good then my husband got a shrimp and oyster po boy and I ordered the jambalaya which was a small portion for the price and lacked flavor the po boy my husband said wasn't what he was expecting the seafood needed more seasoning also the fountain drinks we ordered had a tap water after taste and the server was very lethargic and I wouldn't say unfriendly but did the bare minimum with my husband and I but with other tables seemed to host them well asking about their food where they're from how they're enjoying it... I give it 2 stars because it was clean so were the bathrooms we got seated fast but the food was a total bust and even more so was the service. I wouldn't go back.
The pizza was delicious, cheese bread is a little too cheesy and the sauce that came with it was cold. But the pizza was delicious!!!!!

I went in to pick up my food and the two girls didn't bother to put their cellphones down to even ask me what I wanted. So I had to tell them my self and told me that my order wasn't ready and after waiting a while it turned out that it had been ready so by the time I was home the food was cold.

My husband loves your pizza But I ordered a Full Cesar Salad and it was the worst Salad I have ever had the lettuce was old and slimy and the dressing was supposed to be a lemon Cesar dressing and it was nothing of the sort it was nothing but plain Mayo and I couldn't even eat it so I went without dinner last night so think twice before you order a Cesar Salad

You sell bread. Stop disrespecting our local health care workers who are putting their lives on the line every day, for you, and your friends and your family. 

Take your anti covid signs down. Believe it or not, it's not a conspiracy. There are people dying from covid at cottage, literally a few blocks up the street from your business. 

Remember, you sell bread. 

That's all you do. Not too important compared to the grand scheme of events we are currently dealing with. Find a way to help the community rather than trying to defy health orders, putting your own customers at risk. Clearly you don't see the message you are sending to your own customers, "hey, come buy some bread, have some soup, stay a while, don't worry, you won't get covid here and we don't care if you do get it."

Bread.

Hey y'all!!!! Haven't eaten here yet! But I'm coming tonight! So excited that I had to review before I even tried it! I've been staring at pics of this chicken for the past hour! Hot diggety!!!!!!!!! That's what I call some good grubbin!!!! Anyways!!! I'll update everyone as soon aS I get there. For now I am an advocate and activist for this establishment and everyone involved  in running and supporting it. I would like to say that I Have a problem with spicy foods normally but I am ready and willing to  power through ..... also FUCK  those piggy chips loook   !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

Nice little place in Bywater. Bakery goods, scones, cinnamon rolls, sweet rolls, bread, etc. Seating for maybe 25. They let dogs in here, and when I went a bad owner let his mutt bark continuously instead of taking him outside. 
Then the have breakfast and lunch sandwich stuff. 
THE FOOD: I had a great Americano coffee. Rich, dark, tasty. 
I had Shrimp Etoufee with eggs and grits and found out it comes in a "to go" paper coffee cup. SO good! Only a shrimp or two, but great flavor if you mix it before eating (eggs and grits on the bottom). 
I ordered a BLT to go for lunch and a cinnamon/pistachio scone for the next day breakfast. 
The BLT was very good. Great quality bacon done well, tasty soft bread with mayo and lettuce and tomato. It's a good sized sandwich also.
The scone was perfect. Loved it. 
The place is clean, has some interesting decor, and the staff is friendly. I'll be back.

Thank you for opening in Boise! My only qualm is that I wish you were bigger so that there would be more seating. Coffee is great and the goods are delicious. Also, I can't forget to mention this place is insta story worthy, for all my basic people.

Beer selection was subpar for a place marketing itself as "World of Beer." Female bartender was racist and ignored my husband and myself when we wanted to order. She eagerly waited and served every other patrons who were white . Then she threw my card at me when I requested to cash out. Avoid this place if you have any shade of brown skin tone.

Best wings I've ever had. Great management and staff. Always friendly and highly alert to their customers needs. They earn extra points for clapping back against @IvanaKaren self righteous Cuban review below.  thx for being a great Tampa staple, Hattricks! And plz put more celery with your wings!!!

This place has some REALLY good ground chicken. The flavors of the chicken were really awesome. The rice was also good. Be warn though, that the chicken is more American style, then Arabic style. Don't expect any kind of authentic Arabic food from this place.
Great experience at delivery. Empanadas were great on service was good atmosphere was good. We go back again after I highly recommend it for everybody.

I was wavering between 3 stars and 4 stars... I think the food is okay for Korean food. I do think its the best Korean restaurant in center city area for its combined quality and variety in Korean dishes. But I don't think it is the best Korean food I've ever had.

The service every time I've gone is honestly ok. The servers tend to forget items like drinks and last time we went there was a significant delay on one of the dishes my group ordered. I feel like the kitchen forgot to make it and they had to scramble to make it after they realized one of the dishes was missing.

I questioned giving 4 stars because I do LOVE when I order take out and they give me all the banchan in little containers. I think that touch is very nice. Not a lot of places do that.

Food that I've had there:
Bibim naengmyun - good but very soupy, almost like a combination of bibim and mul naengmyun
Dukbokki appetizer - okay
LA Galbi - okay, not super marinated/tasty like other places
Bibimbap - pretty solid

For convenience sake, I like coming here because it's right in the city but if I was willing to travel outside a bit, Dae-bak would not be my first choice for Korean food.

I came to Tijuana Flats for the first time last night with a group of women from our church. Every single person loved their entree. I ordered the beef chimichanga and it was delicious. We also had the cookie dough dessert and oh my goodness, it was so good! The staff was friendly and attentive. Our entire group agreed that it was a wonderful experience and I'm sure your location has gained some new customers from out group.

Came to this place with my wife and we got seated right away. It took forever for the server to get our drinks and even longer to get our napkins, NAPKINS    Place was not that busy for the server to forget about us. Food was good but services here sucks.
The food has always been amazing here.  However, last night my meal was more oil than sauce which caused my system to react in a negative way.  The first time I've been disappointed.

I patronize Chick-fil-A's throughout the state of Florida in my travels. This Chick-fil-A on North Dale Mabry by the stadium in Tampa has the absolute worst customer service Of any Chic-Fil-A I have ever been at.

The employees do not know the first thing about customer service. The service is horrible. When they make a mistake they refuse to take responsibility and correct the mistake. They refused to identify who the owner is and they refused to give you a telephone number where you can file a complaint regarding any issues at the restaurant.

The owner of the restaurant is Carlos Brito. After speaking with Mr. Brito I can understand why his employees act the way they do. He himself does not know the meaning of customer service. I obtained Mr. Brito email and telephone number. . I emailed him and asked him to call me to discuss my experience at his restaurant. He replied by saying I had the wrong Carlos Brito in the email. I then proceeded to contact him on his personal cell phone he didn't give a hoot about my experience. He was only concerned how I had gotten his phone number. He spoke over over me, argued with me, lectured me on how I got his number. He did everything except show a concern or desire to hear my experience at his restaurant. 

Mr. Brito claims to be this Christian protestant former pastor but believe me his Christian values are as fake as the president he currently worships.

The night of my unpleasant experience at this restaurant I went up the street to

This place is ridiculously expensive. Not only that, but they put barely any alcohol in your drinks and charge you more than everywhere else around. DO NOT waste your time & money. I watch reviews on restaurants because I want a good place to go, with good reviews. That is not this place. They don't deserve good reviews. The only thing they have going for them is being right on the beach.

**Please read*** I do want to say want one additional thing though, had I not had to deal with the long hair, blonde bartender (bigger girl), I could likely give this place higher reviews. She is the one to blame for all the issues I had and I truly hope they take my suggestions tomorrow and get rid of her.

It was around 5pm and one of the two workers there forgot my drink. I called them and no one answered, the doors are locked because of covid. the only thing left I could do is... get back in line and wait another 15min because the drive thru lane is only one lane long. After waiting another 15 min in the drive thru, I didn't receive any compensation for what they forgot! Terrible service and won't ever come back until they fix the drive thru lane and hire more workers.

I held out in In-N-Out for a long time! I didn't understand the hype and felt like it couldn't be THAT different from other fast food BUT I was very wrong.

In N Out is a just a great burger. From the buns, to beef, to the toppings, it's simple and freaking delicious! 

During the pandemic, this has become a go to outing for the family. It's fast, easy and delicious, the kiddo always has a big smile, and so do we when we get home to enjoy it. 

I even found a new way to complicate my order! Did you know you can have a WHOLE grilled onion on your burger? Well, you can! Just ask for it. That's next level In N Out enjoyment!

I've been here before for an event on the roof which was wonderful. This time I dined in on the bottom floor. Overall great experience. 
The Apple Margarita was really good, it was sour, but the apple made it a good sour. The buffalo chicken egg rolls was great! The sweet chili (I think that's what they were) wings were really good as well.  Though the jerk oysters were good, I don't think I would get them again. Just not what I want on my oysters. My entree was the seafood egg roll bowl. Ummm It was good but I think I expected more flavor. They had the sweet chill sauce on the salmon that topped the bowl, but it wasn't throughout. My table mates has the ribs, lobster Mac, and Alfredo and they loved it! I am definitely coming back to try other items on their menu.
Amazing food, great service and perfect atmosphere! So happy to have Enza in the neighborhood!!

One of the best restaurant experiences I've had in a long time! 

My friends and I decided to come here after hearing great things and knowing how good the restaurant Peche is (I believe they are owned by the same people?). It was easy to get reservations online the week of so I was surprised to see how crowded it was when we arrived (not a single table was empty and there were a few parties waiting). The hostesses were very friendly and had no qualms about letting me sit at the table while I waited for my friends to arrive. The restaurant itself is gorgeous-spacious and modern with a beautiful open kitchen area, will definitely stand out among the sea of other great restaurants in the area.  

The food was wonderful! We ordered all 5 of the small antipasti plates (marinated olives, tuna-stuffed peppers, caprese salad, eggplant, and mushrooms). Our favorite was the eggplant! The portions are small so this was the perfect amount to split between 3 people to get a little taste of everything. We also ordered some focaccia bread (YUM) and each ordered a pasta dish...delicious!! I had the rigatoni with walnut pesto and it was perfection. I also tried a bite of my friend's carbonara and it was absolutely divine!! It totally had me wanting to come back just for a bowl of that warm, creamy, bacon-y goodness. They also have some great wines by the glass as well as tasty cocktails with classic Italian flavors (think Campari and Aperol). 

The real kicker of this whole dining experience
Good food and service. I recommend ordering a variety of items and sharing them! The chicken egg rolls are definitely worth a try!

First time trying Thai Town and it was an excellent dining experience. The food was delicious. I got the lunch special chicken pad Thai which came with a spring roll and thom yum. I had never had thom yum before and it was delicious. All of the food was great. The service was exceptional. Super fast and super polite. Highly recommend if you're in the area and want a quick delicious meal.

Great review a terrific place great food service outstanding quality one of the best restaurants I've been to in a long long time wouldn't miss it will be going back often got to try their lunch on Fridays

I have yet to have a bad experience at this restaurant. Their chorizoqueso is awesome, their burritos are over stuffed and delicious. Great flavor, perfectly prepared and my go to. I would definitely recommend this place for good Mexican food.

First visit and they are off to a great start. Table was ready on time, servers assistant and server Jeanna were prompt and very helpful. Started with battered Lobster bites... OMG, simply delicious and served with a bed of thinner than shoestring potatoes. Caesar salad was just fantastic with fresh made croutons. Shell had fillet Oscar and she summed it up in one word, "there are no words for how good that was"! My 12oz fillet was the best I've ever had, period. Delicious seasoning crust on the outside and the meat on the inside was melt in your mouth. I've eaten a lot of steaks in St. Louis and around the country, there is NOT a better steak as far as I know... Citizen Kane's? Nope. Ruth's? Nope. Fleming's? Pahlease! This was the best I've had hands down and not even close. Service was impeccable and attentive without being pushy at all. I've found a new favorite restaurant and expect them to be around for years to come. AWESOME EXPERIENCE, EVEN MORE INCREDIBLE FOOD!

I was first introduced to this pizza when in Arizona going to see a game, loved it!!!!!!! Found the one in Tampa and guess what, loved it!!!!!! When in Tampa I will always stop to get a pie. My favorite and my family's favorite.

After a few hours looking at art, we needed a little respite.  We thought maybe a little drink would hit the spot.  However........
A nice choice of wine, spirits, specialty drinks and standard sodas available.  The menu though, so many interesting choices.  We decided on the cheese board and the beet sliders. My friend and sleeping baby chose a seat on the long red banquet.  I wait in the growing line.  

Hot tip for all : if you're in a long line, take that time to know exactly what you want.  
Second Hot tip: have a plan B.

I get to the front, I'm ready.  The cheese board, beet sliders, 2 pomegranate ice teas and a sparkling water. Uh oh.....panic in the kitchen. They're out of the cheese board.  No problem, two tomato bisques and 2 orders of bread.  The gal at counter thanked me......thanked me? She said thank you for being so understanding and knowing what else you wanted. 
And through a fate unforeseen, it was the perfect combination.  The soup was delicious, the bread was hot, we had a whole conversation about the beet sliders.
I enjoyed our meal and the time spent there.  

I love the art at NOMA, the gift shop too.....and now its lovely little cafe.

Cliff notes: tasty but pricey, upper middle aged clientele. 
Long narrative: my husband and I went for dinner tonight. We go maybe twice a year. On the whole, their food is good to good+, but you are going to pay about 20% too much for your experience. 
Their shrimp cocktail is excellent, big shrimp served with a tasty jicama and avocado salad.  We had the wedge salad; it was ok. Fresh but unimpressive. My husband had the filet: excellent.  I had the short rib ravioli: good. The pasta was a little thick and chewy at times. Cookies and chocolate truffon for dessert: good+. The cocktails were delicious and appropriately strong. 
Our server Napoleon was great. 
The Yardley Inn is solid every time, as long as you know you are going to overpay. Also, some diners are loud and entitled. But hey, it's Yardley.

Funky, Cool Corner Bakery with outside seating! To add a nice touch had a musician with a keyboard singing some New Orleans style songs. The menu seemed to have a few interesting items called breakfast "go cups" ( breakfast in a cup) However, we were there to partake in the KING CAKES! Soooo... on to that!                                                   The Carnival king cake is "good" it's not overly sweet. If you like the traditional McKenzie king cake (from back in the old school daze) you will enjoy this Version of King Cake. It has just a little bit of something extra to it but nothing over the top. If you didn't know to look for it you wouldn't know it was there. We were still full from lunch so we will try the Boudoin tomorrow. Review to be continued.                                                                Now.. on to the Boudoin King Cake! First.. I was not sure what to expect, I have never had a boudin king cake. With that being said- my impression of this king cake is a "Boudin pot pie". The filling is delicious but very Rich and the bread on the outside is very tasty topped with colored cheese. It's definitely like something I had never eaten before but a good "different"! Both cakes are totally different than the traditional king cake but you should try both!

You will want to check this place out! Convenient to park, fresh, awesome sushi. Had the lunch buffet today and it didn't disappoint. Love the concept behind Cummins Station too. Great experience every time!

I am so happy my fiance introduced me to this place. The food is amazing. My favorite wings are the Garlic Sriracha, they are delicious! The only downside is they don't deliver...I wish they would offer it because I would definitely order from them!

Rude bartenders this evening. We came here last night great.. tonight completely different. Took my chair while the establishment was slow as a paying patron I thought this was very peculiar. The female bartender tonight ignored me then after buying a few rounds told my wife she couldn't break a dollar for the trolley. 
The band was good but service was severely lacking...
Portions are perfect. Food is fresh and delicious. The English muffins are great! My daughter got the granola and yogurt and she loved it.

When I first moved to St Louis in late 2016, I was happy to have found Wudon in 2017. For the record, I lived in Seoul for a while and being able to find a 'beef & leaf' joint was awesome. It was pricey but good, key word "was". Sadly over the last 3 years their quality has gone downhill and their one good server is no longer there. The service sucks. You have to ask multiple times to get things, when the staff walk by and see empty drink glasses on the table, they don't offer refills. They no longer offer refills on banyan either. They'll not pre-bus the table, was not a one time deal either, this has been over multiple visits. But no more, I will not give any more chances.
Awesome place.  The service is amazing.  Food and drinks are great and they get a really nice crowd.

So far I like this place. It clean atmosphere and meats are fresh. We did have to wait 45 mins but they have a pretty good system to contact you so you can walk around Chinatown. 
Gotta try it again soon.

Such a cute little spot with a bar and plenty of places to sit and eat outside. Let's talk about the Cuban sandwich delicious it had a mojo sauce never had it like that. Very crispy and worth every penny. Such a reasonable price for a Cuban. We also got the pastelitos with guava and cheese soo good. Definitely recommend going her if your in Tampa.

Surprisingly, it did not taste dry, but rather juicy. They took out the big bones to stuff the wings. The sweet Thai chili sauce gave an Asian taste to it. Maybe they should experiment and add more flavor options to these plump wings.

We stopped by for lunch after some long hikes in the park and found some wonderful food. The corn tamale was awesome, with a hint of honey sweetness and moist beyond belief. Rice and beans were very tasty and the service was wonderful. Would highly suggest a stop there. GPS does make it hard to find but just stay on 12th and you will find it!

I love this place. Everything is always so fresh and there are so many options or variations you can get. I feel like the pricing is good for the amount of food you get. And who doesn't love a free froyo for after?? 
My favorite is the butternut squash soup with any of the salads. And the wraps are too die for. So really I don't have a favorite! Try it all!!

My friend has been there multiple times as it is her backyard. Myself and another one of our guest went last week and even during Covid still had a wonderful experience. That being said we wanted to bring somebody else with us and unfortunately it was a horrible experience for all four of us. The main reason we went was for the baked oysters long story short our entrées came out and our oysters never did, we ordered our oysters as an app. We ordered four appetizers got three of them and then got a shrimp basket we never ordered! The runner was messing up all the food orders ladies at the next table had to yell across for their Caesar salad that he was trying to give to us. He said forgive me it's my first day! We got food we didn't order we didn't get food that we did order every check was messed up we have three different servers throughout the hour and a half lunch the one who started it never came back not even acknowledge look our way or apologize. When she did come back to drop off a refill of a drink we asked if she could take a picture she said one minute walked away and never came back our food was auctioned off no one knew what was going on. Our first server that started us off didn't bring a pen or paper, iPad nothing to take for separate order drinks, appetizers, entrées and specifics! Even a seasoned server cannot possibly be that good! Which proves our point! It was so disappointing to bring a new friend for her first experience, as she is moving closer to the ar

1/5/20:

The food was so good last time, we had to order again. 

Deliver was fast, but we had some food issues.  The burger was just charred and burned.  The largest of the wings (drums), about half, were still pink with rubbery skin..  They are large in size and very well sauced, but the cook on them tonight was not awesome. 

I'm sure we'll try again, but may take a break. 

Had an AMAZING experience with Wings Etc. via Door Dash delivery. 

We ordered poppers and fried pickles.  Both arrived HOT and CRISPY.  Now, they appear to be straight outta the freezer and not hand breaded.  That's okay, but it was unexpected, especially with the pickles.  They came with the appropriate sauces.

Entrees were wings and one of the home wreckers, which is a thick 11" hot dog.  You see what they did there, right?  It was a nicely flavored hot dog smothered in tasty chili.  The wings were meaty, crispy, and well sauced.  The Asian Kick and Hot BBQ were flavor home runs with a nice heat, but not overwhelming.  They included all sauces, but forgot the carrots and celery that were advertised as an accompaniment. 

Deliciously seasoned fries were fresh and hot.  

Their blue cheese is so good.  It's thick and creamy.  Very much tasty!

We were pleasantly surprised with the speed in preparation and flavor

We LOVE merchants. We come every time we are in Nashville, this most recent time Wendy our waitress at the bar was such a treat! we couldn't have been happier with the service. Thank you Wendy and Merchants for such wonderful meals and fun every time.

Fun atmosphere and good food/margaritas. Be careful as it can get expensive quick but that is true of most places on Mass Ave. This is a Mass Ave classic to me and I absolutely enjoy going here from time to time.

Ate here yesterday with some out of town friends. Great review by our entire party. Nice outdoor atmosphere, with a varied menu and great service. Prices are very reasonable, and the fried oysters are a must! Well worth repeated visits.

This was my wife any my first time eating food from DD Mau. The food was great! We have a daughter in law who is Vietnamese, so we are familiar with the food. Almost as good as hers! Due to COVID, there is no inside dining, so I did a Curbside Pickup. The food was ready on time and the server that brought it out was very friendly and helpful. I had told her it was our first time ordering so she brought me a Takeout Menu to take with me. Portion sizes are good, and there is a very large variety in how you want your menu item prepared. The prices are reasonable. (Remember, even though you can't sit down and eat inside, everyone working there, has to still do there jobs to get you your meal. So, don't forget to TIP!)

I'm glad we decided to go to this place. We were in town visiting and have a couple nights for food and beer. Great beer selection and an amazing menu. 

Ordered pirogies, mushroom pizza, scallops and some Elvis egg rolls as a dessert. All were amazing. Came out timely and were some of the best dishes we've ever had.

Service was great too. All around great experience.

We've dined at Boca Tacos on a few occasions. And for first timers it can be a bit confusing there is NO TABLE SERVICE! we've sat at the bar a couple of times, as we walked up it was evident the bar top had not been wiped down from previous guests. The bartender asked if we were planning on eating at the bar ( you get full service. ) he then proceeded to place menus on the dirty bar top. Halfway through our meal we found out the bartender's name was Jacob. As he yelled this introduction to a guest beside us. We sit a watch as Jacob makes his rounds through the restaurant. He's great at helping out everywhere else picking up dirty glassware and clearing tables, just not the bar top. I watch as he puts the pint glasses into the ice in order to moisten the glasses in order to rim them with salt or other, instead of using a lime for the same effect. Jacob and the young lady running the register bot use glasses as ice scoops. The chef/owner was there had she been just as focused with what was going on with the kitchen and food as the front of the house. She just might have seen the safety and health code violation. As well as neither washed their hands, Jacob wiped his on the bar towel hanging from his belt (also against health code) never washed out the mixing tins before re-use. My favorite part is watching him place his unwashed hands all over the glasses especially where people are expected to put their mouths. Which makes me wonder if this is practiced in the kitchen. No one

Could be better.  My wrap is just warm.      The vibe is very upsetting.  

Falafel wrap is ok.
Great food we sat outside , only restaurant I've ate at and not get attacked by flies !

Was told to check out the steak sandwich if I didnt feel like having a cheesesteak. This place was the obvious go to because it's a staple in the Philadelphia reviews and in the terminal market. Order to go in line or sit down of you find a seat to order and eat there.

Staff was super friendly and no one seemed to care when you didnt know your order or had questions. Very approachable and not what I anticipated for the fast environment and based on my perception of ordering cheesesteaks. 

Food: steak sandwich (brisket) with long hot peppers. The sandwich itself was super filling but overall lacked a ton of complexity/ flavor. The hot peppers were spicy as expected but the brisket felt somewhat overcooked without anything to wow you. I would opt for the many other options available to eat here and skip the hype.

I've gone to this place at least five times in the three times I've visited Philly, and each time I've gone the cheesesteaks have been excellent! The food tastes fresh and flavorful. The bread even has a special "cleavers" imprint on one side of the bun which is pretty clever. The restaurant is clean overall and service is quick. Besides the cheesesteaks, the spicy fried green beans are my absolute favorite and I definitely recommend adding them to your meal if you're in the mood for something really tasty and unique. I would recommend this place to anyone who comes and visits Philly and is looking for a superb cheesesteak.

Best sushi in Tucson, hands down. Don't let the location fool you! I usually get the spicy tuna roll and Philly roll, and they never disappoint. The rest of the menu is also really authentic, fresh, and good. Cannot recommend enough!

I ordered from here recently and the food is better than the other Greek restaurants in the area. Ordering was quick and easy. Their gyro chicken combo is enough to make you feel full for the entire day. I also ordered the grape leaps which taste fresh. I will definitely be returning again.

Outrageous service, it took 20 minutes to get our drinks. Then it took 15 minutes for them to bring our drinks and take our order. Another 30 minutes to get our food and the people who were sitting down before us got their food first. Then when we got our food there was a hair in one of the pancakes. Disgusting, I do not recommend this establishment.
I have had so many things on the menu at this point and never have I once been disappointed. The food is soooo so so sooo good! I would eat here for every meal if I could. Kindest people, as well

I would have given 5 stars because the actual smokin hog sandwich was delicious, so were the pickles and fries. The coleslaw  tasted slightly old, it was very soggy, and barely and crunch. I also wish there was a side of extra bbq sauce. The presentation in the platter was also fantastic. I'll order again, just hold the coleslaw and add extra bbq sauce.

If I could give no stars I would. Food was horrible tried talking to the managers and they blew me off like they were too busy to speak to me. Really has gone downhill, Brandon used to be one of the good ones, thought he was going to take over as GM once Jeff left but they hired some random named Lindsey and she has to be the worst thing that's ever happened to this place. Ever since she arrived the servers look miserable. I've heard the way she talks to the employees and it's so disrespectful and rude I really hope something is done soon. Was in there one day and an employee needed help because for some reason Bertuccis decided to stop her from getting her unemployment check and wouldn't even help her, she got so upset she was crying and the lindsey just ignored her, never seen managers neglect their employees so bad. If this is what Bertuccis is about then count me out, never will eat there again and I made sure to tell all my friends and so on and so forth, we will not tolerate the mistreatment of employees! Hopefully something was does for that server, I've been taken care of by her a couple different times, very sweet, one of the best they have there. Even got me to try a Tuscan with salmon and I hate trying new things which I will definitely miss from there, haven't found anyone else to make it but oh well I'll figure it out. Anything's better then giving my business to one so awful. Hopefully something is done about those managers.

Best BBQ in town and a wonderful addition to The Grove neighborhood. I had the beer cheese steak, which was amazing! And the portion was huge. Looking forward to trying other menu items as well. Well done and well worth it!

Short and simple review! I went for lunch around 1:15-1:30 got the stand poke bowl. They were sold off of the Poke Nachos ( which the chips are made from Won Tims wrappers that they deep fry) 
My bowl had Marinated salmon, brown rices instead of white rice ( which they ran out of white rice about I made it there).
They Gave me a wooden spoon which eventually started to break apart the longer I let it say in my bowl.
I tried something different in my bowl this time around. I normally get mango in my bow but the only carry pineapple so I added that to my bowl. Only mistake I made with my Poke bowl was I had savory mixed with sweet and .. not quite sure I like that: I had Kimchi  and then added pineapples.. not a great flavor profile for me.
I wish they had more seats... I would love to go back and try the Nachos!!!

My feelings about my experiences with Daleng are very mixed. I'm willing to chalk that up to the fact that I've only done takeout, while most of the reviews and photos (which heightened my expectations) were based on eat-in experiences. 

The pros: highly flavored, completely delicious on both entrees that I've tried, specifically the Eggplant and Veggie Curry and the Cambodian Stir Fry with Tofu. The sauce on the eggplant and veggie curry is so good that I could just pour that on a plate of brown rice and happily call it a meal. The tofu in the Cambodian Stir Fry is well prepared, there's lots of lemongrass, which I love, and the the vegetables in both are so thoroughly cooked that every bite is a melt-in-your-mouth party of tender vegetables, flavorful sauce and fluffy rice.
The service is friendly and quick, and for eat-in it looks like they have a good drink selection with really good prices. So I definitely want to have an eat-in experience here.

The not-so-pros: In spite of other reviews claiming the contrary here, the portion sizes are not really that generous. I feel like for the price, the portions might have been what you would expect for a lunch portion from a restaurant that was less "takeout-esque" (borrowing Karen X's brilliant wordplay there) than Daleng. They don't really pack the takeout containers, which is understandable because there's A LOT of sauce and it was spilling out even from the 3/4 filled containers. The amount of rice was a little harder to for
Just WOW! Great People, Great Sandwiches and Great Pickles! Where can I find more stars to give this place!

My aunt recommended this place, so we decided to try it one night when uninspired what to make for dinner. Their menu may seem small, but the things on there are fantastic. Their employees are super patient and nice. My brother ordered their Ramen for his main dish, and that was by far the best thing we got (although everything was amazing)

My wife and I love this place. Nothing in that menu will disappoint you. Good ambiance. Great service.  Good prices. Several locations in South Jersey. Quite popular. Make reservations to cut down on the wait. 5 Stars

We had a wonderful stay. We were in town for a conference and I was amazed at how well the hotel accommodated over 2,000 teachers. While here a member of our group's husband passed away. The hotel manager was amazingly helpful and arranged for a private car to take her to the airport. I realize it was a small thing for them but it meant a lot to her. Thank you

We're here from Atlanta moving my daughter into UPENN and we were starving! This pizza was absolutely delicious  and the manager was so helpful. He helped me with my custom pizza and it was so good!!!!! Thankyou! I highly recommend this restaurant.

We were from out of town and stumbled upon this place. It was very cute inside, and we were helped right away. We really enjoyed the food, and the service was great! Although it was busy, our waitress checked in on us and was very kind. Can't beat the prices either!

I really like the food at the gyro shack and it's always fresh! One thing I would suggest though is maybe have the employees trained a little better on making any gyro into a rice bowl concept. I ordered the Z in a rice bowl and they had forgotten 3 major ingredients (feta, Peppercinis, and tzatziki sauce) which would have made it cheaper than what I originally paid for..I went back through the line to ask about the mess up and the girl was super nice and accommodating but she  didn't seem to know what all it was suppose to come on it..
Great food all in all.
Very very clean!  Was nice to sit inside and have dinner,  Good variety on buffet.  Not everything they usually have but its just getting back open

Very elegant place, good service, and food was great.

The food seemed pricey at first but very much fitting for 5 of us with only 3 dishes (two double orders), too much carbs:

Pork pizza - very well done crispy crust and sauce and the pork slices were very flavorful. 4.5 stars.

Squid ink linguine, pretty unique, the minced crab was quite delightful. 4.5 stars.

Fusilli with tomato sauce, maybe sausage, this one had a weird taste though well cooked, barely 3 stars.

Overall pizza was a great deal, pastas so so.

I only ordered from there once, but I'm not going back. 
All three steak tacos were bland and really cold. If you're in Warminster 
go to Rey Azteca for Mexican.

I'm from NYC originally and moved to the Vorhees area about a year ago. Had been looking for a good Indian restaurant and Nimit was recomend to me by a friend, I'm glad it was. Nimit gives an authentic taste of Indian food without dumbing down the spices and flavor profiles. It has become my go to for great indian food in the area. The host Bajwa is excellent and always ready to answer any questions I might have. I would recommend this restaurant to anyone and have done so.

This review is not about the friendliness of the staff or the atmosphere. When I arrived I was greeted by a very polite host. Once my group was seated we ordered a pitcher of a strawberry margarita. First we had to wait 10 minutes for the pitcher to arrive because it fell at the bar. Additionally, the pitcher was only 32 ounces (this is stated in the menu), which could have been fine if it did not consist of 50% ice. Due to the excessive amount of ice, the pitcher only filled three, 7 ounce plastic cups. It was $33 + tip,  poorly spent. If this is how the restaurant serves their pitchers, they should suggest that one pitcher might not be enough for three customers.
Their orange & vanilla twist soft serve is delicious! Their peanut butter and black raspberry soft serve was good too. Their mint chocolate chip ice cream is decent as well.

If I were just rating on the flavor, I think we're really talking 3.5. If we add in the excellent service, it tips the scales to 4 stars. Place was spanking clean, service was helpful, friendly, fast. My sweetheart of a server gave me a small tasting of the 3 different hummus - regular, red pepper and spinach. They were creamy with a mellow flavor. Fave was the regular. The menu is rather extensive - more so than necessary I think, but, hey, I'm not the kitchen cooks, so it's all good with me. It's a nice place to have lunch though I think the happy hour is probably the real draw here given its location and clientele (Valley folks) who are always in need of more decent bar,/restaurant choices. I think the only thing that keeps me from being a bit more excited about this place is I feel the flavors are pretty tame and even the garlic sauce isn't that garlicky. The servings are generous though and I would come again &  order items there menu lists as spicy and see if that rings my bell a bit harder. All in all, good food good place good value.

Zayna is an excellent place to get shawarma and falafel sandwiches (or plates). The quality is excellent, and the potatoes / fries that come with the meals are amazing...we always get an extra side order of them because they are so delicious.

Once you start going, you can't stop! It has become an addiction, no complaints whatsoever. 
I love to build my own spirulina bowl and add whichever toppings i'd like. It's very nice to have that option!

We put our name on the waiting list about 20 minutes before coming on a Saturday around 11:20am. When we arrived we waited for probably another hour. The space is open (and loud), but decorated very nicely. Our server was good (kind and efficient). I got the vegan waffle and vegan Benedict dish. The tempeh was seasoned well and the waffle was tasty, however I wish it had veg cool whip. I also tried the pistachio latte , but I didn't enjoy. Maybe pistachio mocha would be good? Or maybe I just don't enjoy pistachio in my drinks, not sure.  When I visit again I would like to try the tofu scramble and avo toast.

There was a line every time we went but it was worth it plus it moves fast
 We had breakfast the first day plus we tried their great and famous beignets.. uff they just melt in your mouth.

I come to Thinh An weekly for vegetable spring rolls, veggie egg rolls, and tofu bahn mi. The food is always out quick, and it's super cheap. The staff is really nice except for the older man who seems to run the place, he's pretty rude and unprofessional. However, I think I new guy is running it now and he's the sweetest.

First and last time visiting. Sat at the bar , then finally got waited on. The tall bartender was just totally ignoring myself. Got my drink and wanted to order appetizers. Bar was not crowded at all. About 15 minutes later ordered appetizers,  simple ones. About 25 minutes later got them cold. Ate them l was on a time schedule,  stood up to pay my bill and was ignored. Was going to use a credit card  for 20.00 and some change. After 10 minutes of standing there with my card on the bar
 I picked up my card and the nice cash tip, put down a 20.00 and a one and left. Terrible service period.

I made a reservation here for dinner because I was on a haunted ghost tour and one of the stops was actually at this restaurant! They have a table set up for the ghost there and I heard that you can ask to check it out if you eat there. If there is no reservation for that table that is!

Besides the history, I think this is a great place to have dinner. I love the ambiance and the food is reasonably priced. They have a 3 course meal for only $45 which is such a steal! 

I got the seafood gumbo, the shrimp & grits, and the bread pudding. The bread pudding was a bit too sweet for my liking but everything else was great. The food took awhile to come but the waitress gave us a free drink on the house for our wait so it was okay. Overall, I would recommend coming here.

Tried a new Thai place. Have heard good things, but our first try was good not our favorite. We got the red curry, chili chicken and ginger chicken. Quite a bit of food for what you're spending which is a plus, we selected the hot option and were happy when we were greeted with spice and heat. The flavor was good but we've had some others we've liked more. Will try again with different menu items.

Went for a needed burrito run and have always wanted to try the burritos and horchata latte here! Let me tell you it did not disappoint! Loved how the burrito comes in two little burritos! My friends were also very satisfied with their burritos!

It's been a while since my last review of this place, so I'm just coming back to say that this place is STILL amazing and they're STILL my favorite restaurant in the Philadelphia area. Over the years, I've gotten to know the owners and staff at Indian Garden and they are friendly people that care about their customers and are passionate about making great food. If you like or are even remotely curious about Indian food, you owe it to yourself to try this place.
Perfect end to the day. The meat lovers was fantastic and the crust is absolutely perfect. A must have!

*wipes tears 
Smh. 
*glances at sky.
Thank you lord.

Never have I experienced such goodness.
I'm a NOLA Chef.
I'm a foodie.
I'm a PICKY CHEF. 

This was phenomenal. 
My experience before and after getting my food was stellar. 
Great customer service. Fast. Cool staff!

You know how NOLA isn't known for Philly's? 

It is now.

Idk if that bread came in a bag but if it did Jesus blessed it. Amoroso bread? No idea if it was but it was FREEWESSHHHH. Sooooofftttttt. HAD to be fresh baked. If not I need to know the secret 
Ugh 

The meat was seasoned to perfection, not too lean, not too fatty. Cheese  to meat ratio was perfect! 
I like a real Philly and I got it! Look no further. 

Now let's talk about fries. 

Truth is ppl neglect sides, especially fries. So tired of dry shoestrings and tasteless crinkle cuts. Yuck! And those Waffle things like po wait in Presidential length lines fir a Chik "whoever"---I don't get it. I just don't. 

These are crisp yet moist inside home fries with the perfect amount of salt and I swear a little butter-like pan fries! I wanted to cry. I think I did a little. 

Amazing how Mickey D's sold over a billion burgers with those dead matchsticks they call fries. 
If you like em fine but just know you're going to heelllllll. Lol 

Now.....the best for last and I'm gonna make it simple..
If I was stumbling down some stairs....drunk....holding that fried lobster sammich and my kid and lost my footing annnnnd had to pick which to grasp real quick ..........
Got the Bleu burger and added bacon to it - fantastic! Fries were fantastic and the Texas onion/jalapeño fries were tasty with a side of ranch! Definitely a new fave burger joint!!

Love this place! It has a large variety of wines to choose from and service is great.  They have many wines by the ounce, which is great for sampling.  They sell by the bottle to go also, and have many buy one get one free that are very good.  Owner is here often, and very social.  This place will not disappoint.

The actual food was not too bad. All of the crust on the pizza was so crunchy it seemed burnt. This review goes more the service we got from the manager of the restaurant, Brian. We got to the restaurant and the host at the door told us that it was no problem if we were not wearing masks if we wanted to sit outside because my wife had left her mask in the car. We were about to be seated before the manager walked up demanding we wear masks in order to be seated. We tried reasoning with him regarding the recent update lifting the mask mandate in FL but he would not have it. The host and waitress finally butted in and told him that we were just staying outside and we would not be entering the building. We are not anti maskers but the miscommunication from the manager threw us off.
Following this interaction, we were seated and my father in law went to use the restroom where he found no soap to wash his hands. If you are crazy about us wearing a mask, I believe you should have everything up to perfect health standards for your guests. 
The manager Brian ruined what could have been a much better review.

Stopped in for lunch today.  An old house in an old neighborhood.  Adequate parking.   
Music is super loud but not distasteful.  Ordered chicken PHO and water.  I added siracha to the broth to give it some spice.   
Sat back in a corner and the bowl was quickly delivered.  Used the spoon for broth and the chopsticks for all else.   
This dish was hearty.   I took my time and savored the dish and the ambience.
I really enjoyed the experience.

Sunday Jazz brunch is the thing to do!!! Big shout out to Alfred, Owen and the band for making my sister birthday special. Got the Pain Perdue (yummy and sweet) while the rest of my group got Grits and Shrimp (saucy and savory) and it was all soo yummy with bottomless mimosas. Great potions which had us satisfied until the late evening. 

Would def recommend to all who will be here on a Sunday! They take reservation not necessary but I did it to be on the safe side.

Great food. The house sauce us the best. They do a good job in packing food. 
I wish they provide disposable utensils for crab

Finally had the chance to try this neighborhood restaurant and Reno staple after specifically avoiding it for two years due to all the negative feedback about the owner/hostess. 

Fortunately, we received great service without anything awkward happening, however, the couple at the table next to us was chastised by her for something and I could tell they were upset. 

In any case, the food and drinks were just what we needed. Definitely get a cocktail here to accompany your meal. They have some variations on the classics that are worth trying.

They have a gigantic menu, so you'll definitely find something regardless of your taste preferences. All their Benedicts sounded great, especially the surf and turf, but we ended up going with the lunch menu this day. 

The beef stroganoff was perfect, if a bit skimpy on the beef ratio, and the jambalaya was spicy and satisfying. 

Service was awesome! Tip your servers well during this stupid pandemic!

Don't bother ordering from them if you want a no contact delivery-they don't get it, the driver kept ringing the doorbell when we clearly told the restaurant to leave it outside. I'm done with this place, try Mike's Pizza Instead, better food, better prices and they will leave it outside your door.

Cheese board. Charcuterie board. Side of red beans and rice. Yes please. It was awesome. I was hoping for a better wine selection though. Add eight good wines to the list for a five star from me. Beautiful. Charming. Historical. Tasty. Good service.

Evidently I never updated my initial review for Skipper's and now they're closed for an indefinite period of time, possibly forever (thanks, COVID). TBH, I'm still crushed. I've visited Skipper's quite a few times since (and before) my original & embarrassingly brief review, so I thought I should write a new one even though no one can visit now.

Hubs & I ended up here many evenings when we just couldn't decide where to go for dinner. They always had something for both of our moods. And the food was consistently good! Their cocktails were always decent, if not strong, and well priced, plus their beers were cheap as well.

The dining area was a comfortable space for a couple or groups, as was their bar area... and I LOVED the cozy nooks. Outside offered a lot of great dining areas as well, especially for groups. Plus, the outside bar was handy. 

About 13 months ago, I enjoyed their Stone Crab Claws for the first time and they were SO GOOD. For context, my first taste of stone crab claws was literally four weeks prior (in Las Vegas - don't laugh) but we're not focusing on my FL-native-failure here. They also had great fried okra and fried shrimp. 

The Skipperdome was an incredible venue and felt very intimate. The sound was outstanding as well. In retrospect, of course I feel like I didn't see enough live music here. But I'm grateful for the shows I did see! 

I deeply hope this space endures, even In a pandemic context, because I still can't get my head around Tampa without

As I arrived to the window the server was rude.  I ordered potato salad that was too sweet and too mustardy for my liking.  The brisket was dry with a nice flavor. They may have served me meat from the flat.  The ribs had a nice smoke flavor and tender but look like they came out of an oven and not a smoker.  I ordered a giant brisket potato a brisket sandwich and I half a rack of ribs.  The potato was perfectly cooked and the sauce was pleasant , I chose the mild sauce.  I love barbecue but I probably would not go back to this location.

Happy to support Pisces, especially now during COVID-19. Needing a sushi fix? They are open for curbside pickup! My fiancé and I did the three roll meal X 2 and got six of our favorites. Not that much different from AYCE and took care of our quarantine sushi cravings! Thanks, Pisces! And Happy Easter to you too!

Absolutely disgusted with the attitude of the owner! I don't know why such arrogance. Maybe making too much money?

First order:
3 chicken marooshes
2 beef cheesesteaks
1 order of fries
1 order of wings (5 wings)

What did we get:
2 chicken marooshes
3 beef cheesesteaks
2 order of fries

So you see the problem, right? So to rectify that mistake, I ordered again. This time, I ordered 2 chicken marooshes and 1 order of wings (5 wings). But I called a couple of minutes later to cancel the marooshes. I waited an hour to receive the order. I went to go pick it up. I gave Salaam and said my name and order (wings). The owner asked, "Are you sure it was just wings? Because we have 2 marooshes as well." I told them that I cancelled and he asked me why didn't the lady have it marked as cancelled. I don't know why, ask the lady. Instead of taking accountability, he told me with an attitude, "Please don't do that, okay? We're really busy!!!" Whoa! Still keeping my cool, I said, "Yeah, the first order was messed up too. That's why I'm here again. Is that my fault?" Then he says, "Yeah, well we're busy...." As I'm leaving, I turned to leave the way I entered . Other customers kindly pointed out the exit, so I turned to exit. Then he fires back with a snarky attitude, "Learn to read the signs!!" Seriously? First we waited two and a half hours for both orders,  you mess up, then instead of taking accountability for both mistakes, you blame shift, and now this abrasive comment??? I understand
Good quality food. Tasteful deco. Very clean restaurant. Nice portions. We will definitely be back.
Not bad Chinese food here. They are reasonable. Not good but not bad at all. I may be back here

I really wanted to like this place. It's a neat concept and the decor is beautiful. It's a high end restaurant in creve coeur (which we don't have many of those). Last night i lost all respect for this place unfortunately. I went there with friends and sat on the patio. It's the first day it was open after the St. Louis county order was lifted. I sat outside on the patio and noticed that the tables were not spaced appropriately apart. I should have left right there and then but stayed. None of the waiters were wearing their masks. They had custom masks made with their cobalt logo and the masks were all on their necks. No one was wearing them except the hostess. Each time a server came to our table he got extremely close to our faces, speaking while hovering over our food and drink. People were acting like we weren't going through a global pandemic and things were "business as usual". We are and continue to be in a global pandemic. The reason you were allowed to reopen your business is due to the crippled economy, not because the virus has disappeared. You have chosen not to adhere to the guidelines given by st. louis county on your patio.

The st louis county guidelines for opening a restaurant are posted here. http://stlcorona.com/dr-pages-messages/covid19-safe-operating-protocols/restaurant-operating-protocols/

The protocols clearly state that: "Face coverings must always be worn by service staff unless working alone in an enclosed space that is not involved with food prep
Great little bar in Nashville! Listened to WCB- Wes Cook Band and drinks were reasonable! ($5.00 beers) They serve food but we didn't order any this time. Would come back!

I can't say enough good things about this place! The best part is the dough. Best pizza dough I've had in a long time, definitely the best outside of the East Coast. Pizza is delicious, and the place has a great look and vibe. Just fantastic. The owners are super nice too. I've been many times and I'm never disappointed.

Located on Royal street, it's central location allows for an entertaining ambiance while you're eating dinner. It's open doors/windows concept allowed for a horse to poke its head in the restaurant while we all ate dinner, it was too funny! 

I can't rave about the food enough here. The extensive menu is overwhelming to look at first glance but they have a plethora of French cuisine.

I had the chicken etouffee and it was amazing! My partner had the half and half of crawfish and chicken etouffee. The other couple we were with had the chicken and sausage gumbo and they had nothing but good things to say. 

The only downside semi-slow service, but that just might be the culture down here!
Very friendly staff and the pizza here is amazing!! I Definitely recommend the blood orange margaritas. they are tasty!!
We went to this place based on reviews. We were in Clearwater for a swim meet. It's exceeded our expectations. Food is fabulous!  We went for breakfast here all 3 days in Clearwater. We will be back

Fantatstic! If you want short order style food this is the place! That's right an honest to goodness short order breakfast. The potatoes are fantastic, and they keep the menu simple and fresh. Sausage patties made fresh right on the grill. Grab a seat at the counter and talk to the strangers next to you. This place is great! It's small and it's a bit cramped, but that just ads to the experience. Bravo!

What do I do when I'm craving sushi on a Friday night and don't want to leave my couch after a long night of watching the Birds play? Search on Uber Eats for the best sushi near me...and I couldn't agree more with the rating for Kai Japanese Cuisine. The 3 roll special for $13 is more than enough maki rolls for such a low price, it's hard to beat!! I ordered the 3 roll special with a spicy tuna roll, and salmon roll, and a California roll. As if that already wasn't plenty of food, I also ordered some steamed pork dumplings. Total was under $20 for a meal that could've fed 4 people no joke. Uber Eats had it in my hands in less than 30 minutes and man was it delicious. I ate every last piece of sushi and and every last piece of dumpling. Very impressed with the food and will most certainly be ordering from here again!

By far the best breakfast sandwich I've ever had! I've tried most of them, the fully loaded, the Marlene's way, the uncle. By far my favorite is the sunrise beef. If you want something fresh and amazing this is the spot! I'm so glad I get to order from here. Wether is Uber eats or I stop and pick it up, the quality and attention to detail doesn't change! Keep up the phenomenal work guys it shows in the food!
